problem: Path-aware CI can become falsely green when expected jobs are skipped, a filtered workspace/test selector matches zero work, or heavy release proof is charged to every routine pull request.
invariant: Change-aware CI must calculate an explicit expected proof set, fail closed when required evidence is missing or unexpectedly skipped, reject zero-work selectors, and keep heavyweight full/release proof separate from the normal PR merge gate.
failure_behavior: Fail on missing/unknown/cancelled/unexpectedly skipped required jobs and on an empty expected job set or an expected selector resolving to zero work.
